sl.title: Potek dela
sl.text: Notranji prostor zajamemo s telefonom z LiDAR-jem in videom ter ga v devetih korakih pretvorimo v generaliziran, merljiv 3D model. Skripte v Pythonu piše in poganja AI asistent, samo z odprtokodnimi knjižnicami. Vsaka mera izhaja iz podatkov. Po vsakem koraku pregledamo sliko in povzetek, šele nato nadaljujemo. Pomaknite se navzdol in sledite prostoru skozi vse korake.

en.title: Workflow
en.text: We capture an interior with a LiDAR phone and video and turn it into a generalised, measurable 3D model in nine steps. An AI assistant writes and runs the Python scripts, using open-source libraries only. Every measurement comes from the data. After each step we review an image and a summary before moving on. Scroll down to follow the space through all nine steps.

sl.title: Zajem
sl.text: Prostor zajamemo z dvema LiDAR skeniranjema v aplikaciji Scaniverse, z enim ali dvema videoposnetkoma in s fotografijami elementov, ki jih izmerimo s trakom. Vsak vir najprej pregledamo posebej: število točk, obseg, enote, gostoto, pokritost prostora in znake zamika, kot so podvojene stene ali ukrivljena tla. Za vsak vir izrišemo tloris, obarvan po višini.
sl.tools: Scaniverse, telefon z LiDAR-jem [vnesi: model], merilni trak; laspy, open3d, numpy [preveri]

en.title: Capture
en.text: We capture the space with two LiDAR scans in Scaniverse, one or two walk-through videos and photos of elements measured with a tape. Each source is first inspected on its own: point count, extent, units, density, coverage and signs of drift such as doubled walls or bent floors. Each source gets a plan view coloured by height.
en.tools: Scaniverse, LiDAR phone [vnesi: model], measuring tape; laspy, open3d, numpy [preveri]

sl.title: Čiščenje
sl.text: Oblak razredčimo z vokselsko mrežo 1,5 cm, odstranimo statistične osamelce in ocenimo normale. Oblak zasučemo tako, da so tla natančno vodoravna in os z kaže navzgor. Pohištvo in premične predmete odstranimo, kjer je to mogoče.

en.title: Cleaning
en.text: The cloud is downsampled on a 1.5 cm voxel grid, statistical outliers are removed and normals are estimated. We rotate it so the floor is exactly horizontal, with z pointing up. Furniture and loose objects are removed where possible.

sl.title: Poravnava
sl.text: Boljše od obeh skeniranj vzamemo za referenco. Grobo poravnavo najdemo s primerjavo tlorisov navpičnih ploskev pri zasukih od 0 do 359 stopinj (navzkrižna korelacija), natančno pa z ICP v korakih 10, 5, 3 in 2 cm. Skeniranje z zamikom razdelimo po prostorih ali etažah in vsak del poravnamo posebej. Obdržimo le dele, ki se ujemajo znotraj 5 cm, in jih združimo v en oblak.

en.title: Alignment
en.text: The better of the two scans becomes the reference. Coarse alignment comes from comparing plan views of vertical surfaces over rotations from 0 to 359 degrees (cross-correlation), fine alignment from ICP in stages of 10, 5, 3 and 2 cm. A scan with drift is split per room or per level and each part is aligned separately. Only parts that match within 5 cm are kept and merged into one cloud.

sl.title: Video in SfM
sl.text: Iz videa izluščimo 2 do 3 slike na sekundo in zavržemo zamegljene. S COLMAP izračunamo strukturo iz gibanja (SfM), rezultat umerimo in poravnamo na LiDAR oblak. Video zapolni vrzeli in služi kot neodvisna kontrola, ne kot glavna geometrija.
sl.tools: COLMAP (pycolmap); ffmpeg [preveri]; RealityScan [preveri: ali in v katerem koraku]

en.title: Video and SfM
en.text: We extract 2 to 3 frames per second from the video and drop blurred ones. COLMAP computes structure from motion (SfM); the result is scaled and aligned to the LiDAR cloud. The video fills gaps and serves as an independent check, not as the main geometry.
en.tools: COLMAP (pycolmap); ffmpeg [preveri]; RealityScan [preveri: whether and in which step]

sl.title: Kontrola merila
sl.text: V združenem oblaku izmerimo iste elemente kot s trakom: širino vrat, višino stropa in dolžino stene. Rezultate zberemo v tabeli. Če je katera od razlik večja od 3 cm, postopek ustavimo.

en.title: Scale check
en.text: In the merged cloud we measure the same elements as with the tape: door width, ceiling height and wall length. The results go into a table. If any difference exceeds 3 cm, the process stops.

sl.title: Prepoznava geometrije
sl.text: Oblak prerežemo vodoravno, približno 1,0 m nad vsako etažo, in navpično. Z metodo RANSAC poiščemo ravnine tal, stropov in sten, stopnice in odprtine: vrata, okna in prehode. Višino in globino stopnice odčitamo iz profila.

en.title: Geometry detection
en.text: We slice the cloud horizontally, about 1.0 m above each floor level, and cut vertical sections. RANSAC detects the planes of floors, ceilings and walls, the stairs and the openings: doors, windows and passages. Riser and tread are read from a stair profile.

sl.title: Generalizacija
sl.text: Generalizacija je osrednja ideja predmeta. Pravila določimo pred modeliranjem. Iz oblaka točk ostanejo črte in ravnine, vsako odločitev pa zapišemo skupaj z razlogom.
list: Stena je navpična ravnina s površino vsaj 0,5 m². Pohištvo, cevi in drobne predmete prezremo.
Kote, ki so od 90 ali 180 stopinj oddaljeni največ 3 stopinje, poravnamo na pravi ali iztegnjeni kot.
Mere zaokrožimo na 1 cm. Stopnišče dobi enotno višino in globino stopnice.
Model prikazuje samo notranje ploskve, brez debeline sten.
Ukrivljene ploskve, na primer oboke, poenostavimo v nekaj ravnin ali en valj.

en.title: Generalisation
en.text: Generalisation is the core idea of the course. Rules are fixed before modelling. The point cloud is reduced to lines and planes, and every decision is recorded with its reason.
list: A wall is a vertical plane of at least 0.5 m². Furniture, pipes and clutter are ignored.
Angles within 3 degrees of 90 or 180 are snapped to exact right or straight angles.
Dimensions are rounded to 1 cm. A stair gets one uniform riser and tread.
The model shows interior surfaces only, without wall thickness.
Curved surfaces such as vaults are simplified to a few planes or one cylinder.

sl.title: Model in izdelki
sl.text: Iz ravninskih ploskev sestavimo zaprt generaliziran model s plastmi 01_FLOORS, 02_WALLS, 03_CEILING, 04_STAIRS in 05_OPENINGS. Izdelamo tloris in prerez v merilu 1:50 z glavnimi merami. Odstopanje oblaka od modela podamo z mediano, deležem točk znotraj 5 cm in barvno sliko.
list: združeni oblak točk: PLY, LAS
model: 3DM (v metrih), OBJ
tloris in prerez: DXF, PDF, 1:50
tabela meritev: CSV
odstopanje oblaka od modela: barvna slika

en.title: Model and outputs
en.text: Planar faces are assembled into a closed generalised model on layers 01_FLOORS, 02_WALLS, 03_CEILING, 04_STAIRS and 05_OPENINGS. A floor plan and a section are drawn at 1:50 with main dimensions. The deviation of the cloud from the model is given as a median, a share of points within 5 cm and a colour image.
list: merged point cloud: PLY, LAS
model: 3DM (metres), OBJ
floor plan and section: DXF, PDF, 1:50
measurement table: CSV
deviation of the cloud from the model: colour image

sl.title: Razstava in poročilo
sl.text: Vsak zajem zaključimo s kratkim poročilom: kaj je delovalo, kaj ni, kaj je negotovo in kateri deli prostora manjkajo. Poročilo gre v dnevnik dela. Generalizirane modele natisnemo v 3D [preveri: vse ali izbrane] in jih pokažemo na razstavi.

en.title: Exhibition and report
en.text: Each capture ends with a short report: what worked, what did not, what is uncertain and which parts of the space are missing. The report goes into the work log. The generalised models are 3D printed [preveri: all or a selection] and shown at the exhibition.
